assets.title: The Senator's Goblet
assets.content: The fine Murano goblet from which Falier drank his last. A faint sweetish residue rings the base — the dregs smell of almonds where the wine should not.

assets.title: The Unsent Denunciation
assets.content: Folded in the dead Senator's coat: a formal denunciation addressed to the Council of Ten, naming a poisoner of the Rialto and promising proof — the name smudged by sweat, but beginning with the letter that starts the apothecary's trade.

assets.title: The Scent of Almonds
assets.content: On the Senator's lips and in his cup lingers the bitter-almond breath the physicians whisper of — the unmistakable mark of cantarella, the Venetian poison.

assets.title: The Parish Accounts
assets.content: A small book of parish donations with sums that do not reconcile — coins diverted to cover a private debt. Damning to a priest, but no proof of murder.

assets.title: The Hollow Ring
assets.content: Hidden in a planter on the loggia: a heavy ring with a hinged bezel that opens into a tiny empty chamber, its inner rim crusted with a white residue. A vessel made for one purpose — to tip poison unseen into a cup.

assets.title: The Raven on the Canal
assets.content: A black bird settled on the water-gate just as the Senator fell, the gondoliers say. In Venice they call it a summons — the city marking one of its own for the grave.

assets.title: The Snuffed Candle
assets.content: At the moment the Senator drank, the tall candle nearest the wine table guttered out though no window was open — as if the night itself leaned in to watch the deed.

assets.title: The Verdict of the Body
assets.content: Read plainly, the body confesses what no guest will: the blue lips, the almond breath, the burning in the throat — this was no failing heart and no bad oyster. This was cantarella, given by a hand that knew exactly how much.

assets.title: The Practised Hand
assets.content: Only one guest tonight commands poisons by trade and could measure a killing dose to a grain — and that same guest had reason to fear what the Senator carried in his coat.

assets.title: The Brother at the Oars
assets.content: An old servant remembers that years ago the Senator condemned a Rialto man's brother to the galleys on a thin charge — and that the family never forgave it.

assets.title: The Switched Cup
assets.content: A guest swears the Senator's goblet was carried away and a fresh one brought just before he drank — by a servant no one seems able to name.

assets.title: Voices in the Side Chamber
assets.content: A servant overheard the Senator and his young wife exchanging bitter words in a side chamber not an hour before he died.

assets.title: The Trembling Penitent
assets.content: A sacristan recalls the apothecary leaving Father Benedetto's confessional pale and shaking weeks ago, muttering about a wrong that must be 'set right'.

assets.title: The Council's Cipher
assets.content: A sealed note in a courier's satchel, in the cipher of the Council of Ten, addressed to one of tonight's guests — someone at this ball reports to the Council.
